about: The words the figures registry is written in (src/world/9999977-figures, tools/lint-figures.mjs; D-193). A category is a file of this folder; its kind says how its profiles come to be: fixed (hand-written profiles here), link (another data file's sheets, with an overlay here), generated (people of the world, computed from state by the rule in the file, never stored).

fame.known: its name and its public story are known to all
fame.whispered: only its kind and its count are known; its name and story once you learn them

itemsNote: An item: n, kind, rarity (a word of the one ladder, data/rarity.json, D-200), make (optional: a craft grade of data/rarity.json makes), does, gives.
